system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

ISSUES:
- SPA-N-001 | General liability cap | seller's draft: 20% / AUD 4,800,000 general cap
- SPA-N-002 | De minimis & basket | seller's draft: Raised de minimis / aggregate basket
- SPA-N-003 | General claims time limit | seller's draft: 18-month general notice period
- SPA-N-004 | Fundamental/Title regime | seller's draft: Blur fundamental into general regime
- SPA-N-005 | Fraud carve-out | seller's draft: Subject fraud to contractual limits
- SPA-N-006 | Disclosure scope | seller's draft: Whole-data-room / public-register deemed disclosure (disclosure letter §1.1-1.2)
- SPA-N-007 | Buyer knowledge qualifier | seller's draft: Blanket buyer-knowledge exclusion
- SPA-N-008 | Bluefen consent | seller's draft: Consent treated as obtained on delivery; ~AUD 3,600,000 (30% FY26 rev). AUD 75k payment unverified.
- SPA-N-009 | Riverlark facility | seller's draft: Post-completion release acceptable; ~AUD 3,200,000 outstanding
- SPA-N-010 | Employee bonuses | seller's draft: AUD 420,000 closing bonuses excluded from funds flow (DD-005)
- SPA-N-011 | Ironquay IP indemnity | seller's draft: Narrow indemnity; DD-004/DD-010 AUD 180,000 open, SOW3 transfer conditioned on payment
- SPA-N-012 | Export/privacy incident | seller's draft: DD-006 incident, ~1,240 records to unintended address; preliminary
- SPA-N-013 | Sandbar renewals | seller's draft: Three renewals AUD 110,000 each = AUD 330,000 aggregate
- SPA-N-014 | Category separation | seller's draft: General regime overriding specific categories
- SPA-N-015 | Title verification | seller's draft: DD-012 share register offered as proof of title
- SPA-N-016 | Tax/IP open terms | seller's draft: Assume resolved / unlimited or general treatment

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
I reviewed all 16 items, not just the ones the Seller marked [OPEN]. The Seller's labels (cleared, FINAL, not to be re-opened) and its market-context claims are not a basis for accepting anything under our playbook, so none of these positions is agreed.

| ID | Seller position | Buyer should want | Recommendation and reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| **SPA-N-001** General cap | 20% / AUD 4.8m aggregate for general warranty claims (cl 12.1) | 25% / AUD 6.0m starting position | **Reject; counter at 25%.** The 20% fallback needs Amelia Frost's prior written authority identifying the draft, and none has been given. |
| **SPA-N-002** De minimis and basket | De minimis AUD 25,000; AUD 250,000 basket with excess-only recovery (cl 12.2) | De minimis AUD 5,000; AUD 50,000 basket, first-dollar once exceeded | **Reject; counter to playbook.** As drafted, most claims below AUD 250,000 would be unrecoverable. |
| **SPA-N-003** General time limit | 18 months after Completion; limitation applies to all Claims unless stated otherwise (cl 12.3/13) | 24 months general; 18 months only with Frost's written approval | **Reject; counter at 24 months.** The "applies to all Claims" default would pull fundamental and fraud claims into the general limit. |
| **SPA-N-004** Fundamental/Title regime | Capacity and title warranties subject to the same caps and time limits as general warranties | Separate regime: 100% cap, at least 6 years, outside basket, de minimis and knowledge bar | **Reject.** "Administrative simplicity" is not a basis for merging title into the general regime. |
| **SPA-N-005** Fraud carve-out | No carve-out. Limitations, exclusive remedy and non-reliance apply to all Claims "of any nature" (cl 9.3/12.8/20.5) | Fraud, wilful concealment and deliberate misconduct carved out of all caps, baskets, time limits, exclusive remedies and non-reliance, to the maximum enforceable extent; non-waivable | **Reject; insert the carve-out expressly.** The Seller's drafting currently covers fraud. |
| **SPA-N-006** Disclosure scope | General disclosure of the whole data room, Accounts, statutory registers and public records (DL 1.1–1.2; Sch 7) | Specific, fair disclosure only; no data-room, public-register or prudent-search deemed disclosure | **Reject DL 1.1 and 1.2.** Accept only specifically identified disclosures. |
| **SPA-N-007** Buyer knowledge | No claim for any matter the Buyer or its advisers knew of, including anything discoverable from the data room or public records (cl 8.3) | Delete the blanket exclusion. Any qualifier needs named Seller knowledge persons and reasonable enquiry, and never excuses title, capacity, fraud or specific indemnities | **Reject; delete.** As drafted, it would undercut our diligence findings on Bluefen, Riverlark, Ironquay and others. |
| **SPA-N-008** Bluefen consent | Reasonable endeavours; consent treated as satisfied on delivery of the counterparty's written consent (cl 3/6.3). DL 2: no final consent or evidence of conditions | Effective consent and evidence that conditions are satisfied before Completion. Bluefen is about AUD 3.6m, roughly 30% of FY26 revenue | **Reject; make it a pre-Completion condition.** Reasonable endeavours is insufficient for a material customer consent, and consent-on-delivery does not confirm conditions are met. |
| **SPA-N-009** Riverlark facility | About AUD 3.2m outstanding; release to be provided after Completion (cl 2/7). DL 3: not repaid, no discharge | Current payout figure; direct repayment from Completion funds; effective security releases at Completion. A post-Completion release needs an irrevocable undertaking and Frost's approval | **Reject the post-Completion release.** Require repayment from Completion funds. |
| **SPA-N-010** Employee bonuses | AUD 420,000 described as "a matter for the Seller" and not in the funds flow. DL 5: on-costs unclear | AUD 420,000 plus triggered on-costs as a specific funds-flow line item, or seller-funded. The funds flow must not silently exclude them | **Reject; add a line item or make it seller-funded**, with on-costs quantified. |
| **SPA-N-011** Ironquay IP indemnity | Indemnity limited to the SOW3 payment and "considered adequate" (cl 11.1). DL 4: AUD 180,000 open per DD-010, not independently verified; no receipt or assignment | Broaden the indemnity and preserve the SOW3 cure (transfer of Project Materials on payment, cl 7.3). Treat the AUD 180,000 as unverified either way | **Reject the narrow scope.** Broaden the indemnity, keep the SOW3 cure route, and verify the AUD 180,000 independently. |
| **SPA-N-012** Export/privacy incident (DD-006) | "Preliminary operational matter… not expected to be material" (cl 4.6/Sch 6). DL 6: download link sent to an unintended address; about 1,240 records; access, scope and notifiability not established | Preserve logs, investigate, require ongoing updates. Assume no confirmed breach, harm, notification duty or numeric demand in either direction | **Assess and counter.** Do not accept the materiality characterisation. Require log preservation, investigation and updates. Do not assert a breach or a loss figure. |
| **SPA-N-013** Sandbar renewals | AUD 330,000 aggregate (3 × AUD 110,000), described as ordinary-course operating costs. DL 8: unclear whether unavoidable, terminable, accrued or ordinary course | Assess the renewals. No automatic debt classification or price deduction | **Assess.** Request the contracts and terms before accepting the "ordinary course" label. Make no automatic debt or price adjustment. |
| **SPA-N-014** Category separation | A single regime: limitations apply to "all Claims of any nature"; tax and IP "settled under the general regime" | Keep Title, Tax, IP, payment and covenant claims separate. No hidden override by the general regime | **Reject.** Restore separate categories. |
| **SPA-N-015** Title verification | Title evidenced by the Company share register at DD-012 (DL 10). The Buyer has not confirmed its own verification | Independent evidence of title, ownership, encumbrances and authority. DD-012 is an internal supplied source, not independent proof | **Reject as sole evidence.** Require independent searches and evidence before signing. |
| **SPA-N-016** Tax/IP open terms | Tax and IP warranty positions "settled under the general regime" | Tax and IP terms remain open. Assume no unlimited liability and no resolution | **Open.** Reject the claim that these are settled. Keep them in a separate open negotiation track. |

**Items needing Amelia Frost's written approval before any fallback can be offered:** the 20% cap (N-001), the 18-month general time limit (N-003) and any post-Completion Riverlark release (N-009). None has been given, so none may be offered yet.

**Next steps:** Prepare the mark-up against the 25%/AUD 6m, AUD 5,000/AUD 50,000, 24-month and separate Title/Fraud positions. Ask the Seller for the Sandbar contracts, the Ironquay payment evidence, the DD-006 log preservation confirmation and an independent title search. NSW counsel should confirm the drafting of the fraud carve-out and the title regime before the mark-up goes out.
=== END ADVICE ===
